verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's FAQ states as a default policy that customer code is never used for model training, including by its LLM providers OpenAI and Anthropic. Users get this outcome without opting out, and self-hosted Enterprise customers can additionally opt out of all data retention. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training commitment covering non-code data such as chat, learnings and review context, contractual or DPA-level detail on the provider guarantees, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: CodeRabbit never uses customer code for model training.
Neither CodeRabbit, OpenAI, nor Anthropic uses your code to train our models.
On self-hosted CodeRabbit (available for Enterprise), you can opt out of all data retention at any time
